Scope: roads, storm water piping with catch basins, manholes, box culvert and channels, sewerage network with a sewage lift station, potable water and TSE networks with fire hydrants, 36 kV medium-voltage cables with ring main units, and street lighting. Contract duration 18 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At 97.2% against 79.0% planned under the revised plan, the project is 18.2% ahead. This week it gained 0.69% against 1.21% planned. The earthworks-for-plots and road-works milestones, now forecast for 27-Oct-2026, are still open.

Well ahead overall, but two milestones slipped again and this week fell short of plan. The earthworks-for-plots and road-works milestones, forecast last week for 13-Oct-2026, are now forecast for 27-Oct-2026, and the P6 update (data date 27-Oct-2026) still shows both as not started on that date. Project completion is now forecast for 27-Dec-2026 in both the weekly report and P6, 147 days before the contract date of 23-May-2027; the Remaining Work schedule print gives 21-Jan-2027.

Data notes

  • The weekly report's headline, the summary sheet and the "work done this week" files label a cost-based progress figure as "actual". This report uses physical % complete (man-hours) only.
  • Week number: the Milestones sheet states "Current Contract Weeks: 49 of 79", which is used here. Counting whole weeks from site handover (24-Nov-2025 to 27-Oct-2026, 337 days) gives week 48.
  • The Physical-Chart Data sheet shows 97.7% for October (396,939 man-hours), while the progress sheets give 97.2% to date (394,817 man-hours). This report uses 97.2%.
  • Earned man-hours exceed the budget in eight phases (up to 128% for the open drain channel), and planned man-hours also exceed the budget in three of them. The baseline and revised plans use different totals (406,229 and 406,774 man-hours).
  • Milestones disagree between the weekly report and P6: electrical networks are marked complete on 27-Oct-2026 in the report but not started (03-Nov-2026) in P6; potable water was marked complete on 05-Sep-2026 last week but is now forecast for 02-Nov-2026, while P6 still shows it complete.
  • Completion dates differ between files: 27-Dec-2026 (weekly report and P6 XER), 21-Jan-2027 for project completion and 06-Jan-2027 for the entire project in the Remaining Work print, 23-Nov-2026 as the expected end in the "work done this week" files, and 23-May-2026 as the contract end in one of them (the contract end is 23-May-2027).
  • The Schedule sheet counts 1,176 completed, 28 in progress and 8 not started activities (1,212 in total), while the P6 XER has 1,182 completed (1,218 in total). Several open lift-station and additional-works activities in P6 finish between January and April 2027, after the 27-Dec-2026 project finish.
  • Several files and sheets are unchanged from last week: the Tracking Progress file is identical, as are the procurement log, the issue log, the risk register, the invoice log, the HSE statistics and the inspection counts (FIR, NCR, MIR).
  • The milestone "Complete delivery of all equipment and materials" is marked achieved on 06-Oct-2026, but the procurement log has 9 items "under manufacturing" and one at 4 of 7, and the Procurement Summary has 27 of 34 materials on site.
  • FIR amounts for this week differ: 2,421,817 in the FIR summary and 1,886,072 for week 49 in the FIR log. The Testing sheet's planned dates changed from last week (for example, the road works test moved from 30-Mar-2027 to 12-Jul-2026), and its road works forecast finish is marked actual at only 10% complete.
  • Scope quantities disagree between sheets: storm water 3,791 m (Progress Summary) vs 3,971 m of GRP pipe (Major Quantities); MV network 13,171 m vs 5,632 of 15 kV cable. The Major Quantities sheet gives curbs in m³ and MV cable in m². Shop drawing totals are 394 on the dashboard and 703 on the Quality-Stat sheet.
  • Manpower for October: the dashboard shows 61 planned and 181 actual manual workers (by trade), the Manpower sheet 136 and 149; last week's report gave 156 actual for October.
  • The "work done this week" files give the PM as Abdullah Alshunaifi and place the project in the central sector. The invoice summary counts 3 paid invoices, but the paid amount equals invoices 1 to 6. Several cells show #REF! (issue owners, EAC).
